INJECTION_GUARD_ENABLED.reason: The registered attack-success contract is a security property, not one of the three product metrics, and no powered no-regression evidence exists.

LLM_TOOL_SELECTION_ENABLED.reason: F01 identifies no missing model-selected tool class; the finance graph already invokes its registered retrieval and structured-data capabilities.

MCP_CLIENT_ENABLED.reason: No external MCP server has a registered causal hypothesis for a frozen finance metric.

PRIOR_MEMORY_ENABLED.reason: Its proposed benefit requires prior-run state, while F14 explicitly forbids saved states and cross-run splicing.

PROCEDURAL_MEMORY_ENABLED.reason: Its proposed benefit requires learned cross-run procedures, while F14 explicitly forbids saved states and cross-run splicing.

RAG_ENABLED.reason: The shipped index has 60 filings for 20 US-listed issuers and zero direct overlap with the 14 named companies in the frozen cohort, so activity cannot establish cohort-wide benefit.

REFLECTION_ENABLED.reason: The default reasoner is intentionally synthetic and no finance action policy maps a proposal to a frozen behavioral criterion.

RESEARCH_LOOP_ENABLED.reason: The observed orphan was a downstream selection loss already repaired without another search; no remaining actionable-gap class is attributable to iteration count.

SKILL_PACKS_ENABLED.reason: The finance normalization Skill is H2-ready, but F01 ran it bypassed and supplies no metric-normalization failure census or powered product hypothesis.

decision_rule: Only a capability with a specific causal path to a frozen product metric and an affordable preregistered powered design may enter F09; all others become permanent opt-in.
